headline: Bank of Ghana Rate Cut Lowers Commercial Bank Costs While Corridor Shift Risks Yield Hike
summary: Commercial banks will pay less to borrow overnight from the Bank of Ghana following its policy rate cut. However, analysts noted that a narrower policy corridor could push short-term money market rates higher.
why: The Bank of Ghana's policy rate sets monetary conditions for West Africa's second-largest economy, determining commercial lending rates.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: A central bank rate cut lowers bank borrowing costs while corridor changes affect market interest rates.
